interface: pair_metrics(a,b,*,fe=None,cache=None)->JSON-safe dict; a/b are retained final team rows of same pool/reference/k. geometry_metrics(a,b,cache=None) is an optional geometry-only helper for nested different-k diagnostics.
primary: Unchanged historical joint_stable_strict/main/wide; main remains primary across-method comparator. New shape is parallel sensitivity, never substituted after seeing results.
knowledge_boundary: The 451 Codex followup events and their published results are already known; this is not a new external blind test. New metrics are fixed before new batch learning/selection/evaluation. No human-nearness answers have been collected.
legacy_common: both complete, same original node count, bound correspondence only if same cyclic point-pair count; old implementation imported unchanged
decompositions: geometry_noQ_{strict,main,wide} removes only Q bound, keeping old complete/floor/node/angular conditions; quality_only_{strict,main,wide} retains complete and Q only. geometry_main aliases geometry_noQ_main for Codex criterion compatibility.
shape_common: both complete; valid finite original footprints; no point repair, alignment, scale normalization of the actual geometries, or reference changes. No equal original node-count condition.
shape_scale: sqrt((areaA+areaB)/2), symmetric and same frozen camera-height floor frame; positive footprint areas required
wall_definition: Both directional wall-coverage recalls; min is symmetric coverage. Existing pointwise slab clipping/projected interval union, unoriented wall direction <=10deg. Exact collinear subdivisions do not change boundary.
corner_definition: True turns strictly >10deg, positions matched maximum-cardinality first then minimum Euclidean total distance within threshold. F1=2*matched/(true_corners_A+true_corners_B). Convex/reflex type and wall-angle differences are exposed separately, not inferred semantic necessity.
boundary_definition: 1024 fixed mid-column azimuths. Camera must be strictly inside each valid simple floor. Nearest positive floor-ray/segment hit defines visible bottom boundary and linearly interpolated top edge. Top and bottom angular deviations report mean/p95/max; radial and inferred wall-total-height log ratios report p95/max. At least 99% common azimuth coverage required for shape. These are deterministic sampled visible boundary diagnostics, not full hidden-roof geometry.
boundary_distance_definition: 512 equally spaced arclength midpoint samples per cyclic footprint, symmetric point-to-full-polyline distances normalized by pair scale; mean/p95/max are sampled approximations, never called exact Hausdorff.
coordinates: Frozen continuous ERP x/1024 and y/512 convention, camera height one, floor y=-1. New 3D boundary reconstruction verifies supplied footprint against bottom rays. Old +0.5 angular bound code remains unchanged.
prism_proxy: prism_proxy_pair_iou aliases retained mean_height_prism_pair_iou from old pair metric, using each final row height_mean_ratio; never called true room volume IoU. geometry_shape_main_and_prism_proxy_iou_lt_095 reports possible residual height difference.
exact_solid_definition: exact_flat_prism_pair_iou only if each final top endpoint inferred from paired rays lies at one common horizontal height within numerical tolerance (1e-8 relative +1e-10 absolute), vertical pairs agree, and valid floor geometry exists. Analytic intersection area*min(total heights) / union volume is exact for that explicitly identifiable prism model, not physical scene truth. Nonflat/invalid/unidentified roof => null with reason; do not invent roof triangulation.
failures: All attempted pairs retained. Unavailable continuous metrics null; legacy/new stability false if required inputs unavailable. Available denominators separately countable. No zero-imputation of geometry or Q.
cache: Optional dict caches geometry signatures keyed by geometry bytes; clear per pool or bounded batch. Caches are rebuildable and excluded from delivery.
